speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, glaucoma Social history: Smokes 1 pack of cigarettes daily for the last 40 years, drinks two to three beers on weekends

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma. Based on the 40-year smoking history, diabetes, the 2-month rapid growth, and lack of pain or itching, this clinical picture strongly suggests a non-melanoma skin cancer, specifically Squamous Cell Carcinoma, rather than a benign lesion or Melanoma. I recommend a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis and determine the depth of invasion.
